scope: real PS Vita touch input after first successful game boot

panel_info.meaning: front touch panel initialized and reports the expected high-resolution active grid

root_cause_hypothesis_for_00_10.details: The original TCBManajer input path only queries logical pointer IDs 0..4, while the Vita adapter previously forwarded SceTouchReport.id directly. Vita hardware IDs are not guaranteed to be those Android-style logical slots, so KeyData can contain a touch the game never queries.
root_cause_hypothesis_for_00_10.fix: Keep Vita raw IDs only for tracking continuity and map active contacts to stable logical game slots 0..4. Log the first Begin/End events as raw->logical mappings.
